senses.gloss: वचःक्रम vacaḥ-krama, m. pl. various discourses.
वचस्विन् vacas-vin, a. eloquent.
वचा vac-ā, f. a much used aromatic root.

वाचा vāc-ā, f. speech, word;
 goddess of 🞄speech.
वचोहर vaco-hara, m. messenger, envoy.
वाचंयम vācaṃ-yama, a. restraining speech, 🞄silent: -tva, n. silence.
वाचक्नवी vācaknav-ī́, f. pat. (fr. vacaknu) 🞄N. of a female teacher.
वाचारम्भण vācā‿ārambhaṇa, n. expedient 🞄of speech, mere phrase.
वाचालना vācāl-anā, f. making garrulous.

वाचालय vācāla-ya, den. P. make talkative, 🞄induce to talk;
 make noisy, fill with noise: 🞄pp. ita.
वाचासहाय vācā-sahāya, m. talkative companion, 🞄entertainer.
वाचोयुक्ति vāco-yukti, f. appropriate speech 🞄or word.
वाच्याय vācyā-ya, den. Ā. appear as if it 🞄were really expressed.
वाच्यार्थ vācya‿artha, m. directly expressed 🞄meaning: -tva, n. direct expression of meaning.
